notes: Faster loading. The app was asking for company announcements one share at a time — up to 25 shares per load, each falling through three different routes when the first didn't answer, which added dozens of failed requests and a lot of waiting to every open. It now asks the server once for all of them, and the server answers from the announcements it already collects across the whole market each evening. The two public relay services, which had started refusing every request, have been removed.
